init.title: OpenIOTAI – Settings
init.description: Configure how Home Assistant publishes data to the OpenIOTAI service via MQTT.

data_description.mqtt_broker: Hostname or IP address of the MQTT broker that receives the exported data.
data_description.mqtt_port: Network port of the MQTT broker. For secure TLS connections, port 8883 is commonly used.
data_description.mqtt_topic: MQTT topic under which Home Assistant data is published to OpenIOTAI.
data_description.mqtt_tls: Enable a secure TLS-encrypted connection to the MQTT broker.
data_description.mqtt_username: Username used to authenticate with the MQTT broker.
data_description.mqtt_ca_cert: PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the broker's TLS certificate, if required.
data_description.publish_interval: How often data is published to OpenIOTAI, in seconds.
